title: Google sign-in and optional personal client
blurb: Continue with Google uses the bundled Desktop client by default when present. On first use without accounts, the six-step setup guide includes Google Console JSON import in its mailbox step when Google is not configured. The guide waits for What’s New or another open dialog to close. Later and closing the dialog are remembered on this profile; Settings → General reopens the guide and Settings → Accounts keeps the import instructions visible. Importing does not complete Cloud setup or sign-in. New connections and Gmail OAuth reconnects keep Other email provider collapsed; manual-provider reconnects retain their form. A legacy Gmail connection offers Review Gmail API migration, which opens Accounts without migrating until you review and confirm. Settings → Accounts → Advanced: personal Google OAuth client (optional) imports a Desktop JSON into this computer's app data. An explicit import replaces the bundled client; developer environment variables still win. Web client JSON is rejected and the secret is not shown. Clear imported client removes only that file. Changing clients requires Gmail and separate Calendar reauthorization. Older grants with an unknown client need one-time reauthorization; cached mail and saved credentials stay. Finish or cancel Google sign-in before import or clear; finish the picker before starting Google sign-in. Invalid developer environment overrides must be fixed or removed. Local readiness does not prove Google permits sign-in.
